# Support Channels for EduPlan NG

Welcome to the EduPlan NG community! We are committed to supporting Nigerian secondary teachers and developers.

## Ways to Get Help

- **Documentation**: Browse our comprehensive architectural guides in `docs/` and runbook in `docs/RUNBOOK.md`.
- **GitHub Issues**: For bug reports and verified feature requests.
- **GitHub Discussions**: For general Q&A, pedagogical syllabus suggestions, and implementation ideas.
- **Email Support**: Reach our engineering team directly at `support@eduplan.ng`.
